abstract: Sonograms of 27 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease were evaluated and categorized to newer concepts regarding the pathology and pathogenesis of this disorder. The patients were assigned to the following subgroups: 1) classical or complete mole; 2) partial or incomplete mole; 3) coexistent mole and fetus; 4) hydropic degeneration of the placenta; 5) locally invasive mole; and 6) metastatic trophoblastic disease, including choriocarcinoma. The utility of this categorization and of ultrasound in the diagnosis and subsequent management of these patients is presented.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者27例の超音波所見を検討し、病理学および病因に関する新たな概念に基づいて以下の亜群に分類した：1) 古典的（完全）胞状奇胎、2) 部分胞状奇胎（不完全奇胎）、3) 奇胎と胎児の共存、4) 胎盤の水腫性変性、5) 侵入奇胎、6) 絨毛癌を含む転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患。この分類および超音波検査が、これらの患者の診断と以後の治療において有用であることを示す。
